Astra IPTV Android support

Connect your own playlists and use Astra on phones, tablets and Android TV.

Last updated: 13 October 2026.

  • Contact the developer
  • Connect your sources
  • Playback and Android TV
  • Library and privacy

Contact the developer

Email juan.cazalla.17@gmail.com with your device, Android and Astra versions, the step that fails and the displayed message. Do not include passwords, private playlists or credential-bearing URLs. GitHub issues are public.

Connect your sources

Astra does not include audiovisual content or sell television subscriptions. You need a compatible source and permission to access its content.

Choose Connect playlist on the welcome screen. Select Xtream and enter your provider's server, username and password, or M3U for a playlist URL. You can also import a local M3U file. Add a name of up to 20 characters and an optional XMLTV guide in advanced options.

Connection displays download, preparation and saving stages and can be cancelled. If it fails, check the URL, credentials, internet connection and provider limits.

Playback and Android TV

Astra supports phones, tablets and Android TV running Android 8.0 or later. On TV, navigate with your remote and use Back to return.

Audio, subtitles, Chromecast, Picture in Picture and playback depend on the device, format and source availability. Try another item from the same playlist if one fails. Astra cannot replace or repair a provider stream.

Library and privacy

Settings lets you add, edit, organize and remove playlists, manage playback and choose analytics and diagnostics separately. The Android library is local and does not synchronize with iCloud or the Apple app.

You can use Astra without sharing analytics or crash reports. Read the Android privacy policy for storage, external services and deletion choices.
